words.story: Passengers file down the plane's cramped passage.
A knock rattles the family's tiles; one's irregular.
App in paw, the rat tests equipment rigged above us.
A peal of bells attracts a curious crowd.
Buy a scissors-happy referee who slants every call homeward.
Bulb bribes the judge; his pocket swells with cash.
Carl knocked, and the cat tilted its head.
The chef cocked his head, stirring a devious scheme.
A con man found twins, mixing up nametags.
The con aces a spelling test to compete on TV.
Campers roast corn, then toss the bare cob.
An apple core tops campus's giant text collection.
Rain caught us on the ridge, by a tiny house.
A crow camped in my tent; no room to move.
Dee's new drone was wrecked by a flaw.
Dee flashes a V at us, sneakily pocketing our wallets.
A doe sips from the nurse's measured spoonful of medicine.
The lass grabs a stick, then stretches its rubber band.
Ten pigeons peck, then power the wagon.
Her dress sense defines her true core.
If Victor misses rent, movers will make him leave.
The exhibit's robotic guide described foreign artifacts.
The familiar dog naps by Dell's tea, loyal.
Flipping the mustard, the waiter fumbles, red-faced and nervous.
Flew south, fed ducks; seasons keep changing.
The scout heard hundreds of zebras thunder past together.
High on a perch, nimble birds name one category.
A busker's video: his sin, a crafty finger-tick — peculiar.
In the yard, a float at the gate swells with air.
The printer vents smoke, so the tech steps in.
Stepping in, she wrote one word, then looked deep inside.
He smirks, snubbing me rudely.
Liv taps the glass; a girl peeks out.
Lance flips the little metal catch, sealing the pool gate.
The lagoon guard's digit scan proves ultimately valid.
Trail litter, a nature guide gets written.
The ligament swells like pregnancy, turning cancerous.
The framed mirror crashes, just an ornament to Lee.
A bee abstained all day, then got the queen's reward.
I nod at the strange man wearing a spaghetti hat.
Ommen watches Venus over almond trees, warning of a storm.
At the shelter, she opts for an animal, the best.
Warn the cat: that glass ball only decorates the tree.
Hanging over a peach tree, he stretches too far, falls.
Jolly llamas, snug in matching sleepwear, nod off.
Paula lifts her veil, cheeks flash white.
Pa arches for a moment, then presses goat skin.
The queue of familiar faces all wore odd, wrong smiles.
Off the pier, an eon of peace stretched and ended.
A plum logo hangs, advertising home pipes.
Melissa shows me one palm, five related fingers.
Pam's sound asleep; fists hit her door, again and again.
Ambulances rev; a lens shows flu widespread.
The rat, with caution, doles out equal grain.
A legion's cooks serve Al stew flavored for this area.
Reg, the landlord, lays down a strict house rule.
Revelers gun their engines, roaring with energy.
A fridge stands alone on the long narrow mountain crest.
Wig-wearing clerk stuffs the fixed ballot box.
Though young, she grabbed the ladder's first step.
The satchel of rations soaked up rain until not one drop more would fit.
The bald scalp gleams; the surgeon's thin blade cuts precisely.
Shh, a battered phone drops; its screen breaks into pieces.
Sim ladles hers, gently bubbling, never quite boiling.
Snow hits the pub; the king coldly ignores my wave.
Spoon tips the filled mug; coffee floods the desk.
Watching spawn, she mounts the table, knee-first — toasts unplanned.
Feet stamp, someone peed, doorbusters rush inside.
A doctor steers around the annoyed patient to reach his inflamed knee.
Dust rutted the farm road; a peacock swaggered, tail fanned.
Power surge! An OR goes dark; she operates by headlamp.
Swing deep into the corner; grab the broom.
The sinner watched his nimble mirror-twin mouth the same words.
He grabs the tab; they sit unspoken.
Tom's boss smiles, then lightly throws him the keys.
He trips before the date, revealing a clumsy characteristic.
The trick charmed our jovial judge — a minor act.
Cult baker Lee burned loaves; in the end, perfect bread.
In the hammock, my mind drifts; I relax.
Nurse Venice returns later; the machine breathes for the newborn.
War ended; the king strutted out dressed in pajamas.
Warn the driver: that tire's tread is rubbed bald.
